result.summary: The page is generally polished, with no obvious critical breakage. Two edge-clipping issues make the horizontal content look awkward or accidentally cropped.

issues.description: A category pill is partially visible at the far-right edge but its label is completely cut off, leaving an unexplained gray shape.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel padding or scroll position so enough of the next chip and its label is visible, or keep it fully off-screen.

issues.description: The third card in the “Fastest near you” carousel is heavily cropped, including its restaurant name, which appears abruptly cut off at the viewport edge.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent horizontal carousel peek spacing and apply intentional text truncation within each card so partial cards do not look broken.
